statement: universe-lifted Cech double complex with column comparisons

source.place: Steps 1--2: universe-lifted injective-resolution double complex and its column and total comparisons

proof.text: For each q form K(q), the Cech complex of the cohomology presheaf restricted to Over X. Construct D with D(p,q)=K(q).X p, horizontal differential K(q).d, and vertical differential zero. The horizontal square-zero and shape identities follow from K(q), and the remaining bicomplex identities follow from zero morphisms. No injective resolution or covering hypothesis is needed for this column-only existence statement.

For every p and q, use ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros on the short complex of D.X p at q. Its homologyIso identifies vertical cohomology with K(q).X p. ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.ofZeros.homologyMap_comm gives compatibility with the horizontal differential. Assemble with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents to obtain the required complex isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Direct zero-vertical-differential construction proving the unchanged column-only existence statement; Mathlib zero-differential homology data and its naturality supply the comparisons.

theorem Sheaf.exists_cechDoubleComplex_general_columns
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (X : C) {ι : Type w} {U : ι → C}
    (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) :
    ∃ D : HomologicalComplex₂ AddCommGrpCat.{w} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ),
      ∀ q : ℕ, Nonempty (((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D ≅ (cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i)).obj
          ((Over.forget X).op ⋙ F.cohomologyPresheaf q))
